engine_categories: heuristic from part-row name patterns (bike/truck/pickup/car) + raw MassKg/VehicleTypes/TruckClasses from the Engines DataTable; categories are advisory, mass and tags are authoritative
notes: MaxTorque unit is g*cm with g=10 -> N*m via x1e-4 (validated; 9.80665e-5 gives +2% error)
intake ramp unclamped at min(r,1.0); turbo spool E_sat=TurbineWeight/160 calibrated on Stage1
flat-profile turbos (BaseTorqueMultiplier==TorqueMultiplier) bypass the spool model entirely
EV peak power = MotorMaxPower/10 watts (game unit quirk)
intake/turbo ISEM field appears display-only; effect comes from Slope/BaseRPMRatio
regen_pipeline: mt-pak-extract worktree (skill: motortown-pak-mod-build) -> UAssetTool parse -> bake per references/engine-power-torque-model.md
